source.rigKind: Rigify export with control, mechanism, deform, IK, FK, hose, weapon, and prop nodes

samplingPolicy.method: Build a clean proxy armature from evaluated ORG-bone world-space joint positions and orientations, then bake the proxy before BVH export.
samplingPolicy.spineMid: Interpolate between ORG-spine and ORG-chest on the proxy; never invent a second source control bone.
samplingPolicy.twist: Recover net limb twist from ORG-hand/ORG-foot orientation. Do not export DEF segments or Rigify hose/twist helpers.
samplingPolicy.deformValidation: After retargeting, DEF bones and rendered mesh pixels are validation evidence only. They are not interchange inputs.

applicationPolicy.method: Apply canonical world-space pose deltas relative to a normalized rest pose, convert each delta through the target parent/rest basis, then bake target local rotations.
applicationPolicy.translation: Root/object motion suppressed for this idle-only experiment; joint translations remain rest-derived.
applicationPolicy.scale: Preserve target proportions and bone lengths; no per-model weights in the baseline pass.

acceptance: recognizable target anatomy in every frame
stable feet and root through the loop
hands and arms arrive naturally from the transferred idle
add per-model weights or IK only if the unassisted transfer demonstrates a specific need
